meta.user_notes: Lightspeed w/ Crossed Doors||Lightspeed with Crossed Doors, Key Drop Shuffle and Bombbag. After saving Zelda, collect the 3 pendants to pull the Master Sword from the Pedestal and defeat Agahnim 1. The Triforce is on the Pyramid. Start with Sword, Flute (active after Escape) and 5 Hearts. Boots always available before Aga, Cape never.
